role: exploratory field quality control; no depth reconstruction
selection_note: Crops chosen from metadata and surface preview before these measurement controls. Survey publications were already consulted; this is not a blinded trial.

views.label: Full acquisition
views.description: Incoherent intensity overview of the native complex acquisition. Approximate flat-ground aspect; terrain, layover and shadow are retained. This is not an orthophoto or a subsurface image.

views.label: Eastern Cemetery
views.description: Khufu’s eastern flank, subsidiary pyramids and mastabas. Surface survey points may be projected here; no buried target mask has been accepted.

translation.interpretation: Software calibration using known image translations applied to real texture; these inputs are not ground vibration or evidence of depth.
